title: Missing work and safe continuation
body:
1. Requalify the complete dev10 Architecture Intentions source under real ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196, with Intention Service and ConnectSelector versions correctly locked. The current missing work is NOT the Git source backfill.

2. Implement and test an authentic NotNotes writer adapter against AlchemyNotNotesNode, with a separately authenticated document principal, institutional policy, document type/definition, existing-document revision fencing, retention and publication receipt. Do not assume createDocument/save by themselves implement compare-and-swap or authorization. Do not write an arbitrary document on the basis of architecture approval.

3. Bind SSC verifyArchitectureSscResolution to accepted source authority. Verify component names, source-level/lineage, reachable ::requires, hashes, ambiguity/duplicate identities, stale request and forged evidence. A receipt still cannot authorize deployment.

4. Keep Deployment target/artifact qualification independent, including actual target load probe, native compatibility, package paths and activation approval.

5. Add provider-evidenced costs/quotas and risk estimates, and expose scenario questions plus chosen/rejected explanations over the website/Wire UI without granting the browser any source or decision authority.

6. Preserve the separate Project Alchemy NotNotes v0.6.2 working corpus as document data/provenance; never conflate it with the historical dev15 executable package imported into Git.

7. Dev11 source introduces read-only service-readiness evidence gates. Native r13196 suite is NOT_RUN in this container. Attach externally verified website, own HTTPS, LDAP, SMTP/IMAP and XTP MU/MI named-service proof through their real authorities; do not manufacture production readiness.
summary: Git source backfills completed; runtime, NotNotes writer authority, SSC adapter and Deployment gates remain.
invariants: Architecture selection and review never authorize execution
Unknown qualification fails closed and remains visible
Each external component retains its own semantic and provenance authority

provenance.claim: Exact historical baseline; no new runtime acceptance
